features.name: Add columns from related tables in analysis mode
features.description: Users can now add fields from related tables and pages directly in analysis mode on list pages without requiring developers to create queries. Users can join tables through existing table relationships and perform complex analysis on the combined data.
caveats: Copilot assist is not supported on related fields
Calculated fields are not supported and will be ignored
Limited row display when opening in Excel
Left outer join is used for table relationships

features.name: Open analysis mode data in Excel
features.description: Users can export data from an analysis mode view to Excel, including related columns, for further analysis using Excel tools. Available through context menu on data area or from the analysis tab context menu.
caveats: Row number limitations when exporting to Excel

features.name: AL get URL method parameter for analysis layout
features.description: The AL get URL method now has a parameter to specify that a page should open in analysis mode layout. This allows developers to create direct links to analysis mode views from AL code.

features.name: Copilot analysis assist
features.description: Previously introduced capability that allows users to create analysis mode views using natural language. Not yet supported for related fields.
caveats: Not supported on related fields added through new feature
